description: This Java source file defines an abstract actor class for long-running streaming behaviors with configurable state, status reporting, and stream management using Akka Streams. It provides an infrastructure for actors that constantly run and restart streams, maintain event logs, and report health status.

classes.name: AbstractBackgroundStreamingActorWithConfigWithStatusReport
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that manages a long-lived stream with configuration, logging, status report, and automatic restart capabilities. It is parameterized over a configuration type extending BackgroundStreamingConfig.

methods.name: parseConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to parse and create a configuration object of type C from a generic Config.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the Akka Streams Source that should be repeatedly run.

methods.name: preEnhanceSleepingBehavior
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add message handling during sleep state.

methods.name: preEnhanceStreamingBehavior
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add message handling during active streaming.

methods.name: postEnhanceStatusReport
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to augment the status report with additional info.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message processing behavior, starting in sleep mode.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Updates the actor's configuration, re-parsing it and scheduling wake-up if enabled.

methods.name: sleeping
methods.description: Defines the message processing behavior when actor is in sleep mode.

methods.name: streaming
methods.description: Defines the message processing behavior when actor is actively streaming.

methods.name: wokeUp
methods.description: Handles wake-up signal, updates event log, and may restart the stream.

methods.name: streamTerminated
methods.description: Handles stream termination, logs event, and may restart streaming based on config.

methods.name: getEventStream
methods.description: Returns the current stream of logged events.

methods.name: scheduleWakeUp
methods.description: Schedules the actor to wake up after a specified duration.

methods.name: shutdownStream
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the stream and handles restart if enabled.

methods.name: addCustomEventToLog
methods.description: Enqueues an event into the event log.

methods.name: restartStream
methods.description: Stops any existing stream and starts a new one via getSource().

methods.name: shutdownKillSwitch
methods.description: Terminates the current stream if active.

methods.name: retrieveHealth
methods.description: Handles health retrieval requests, returning status info.

methods.name: renderStatusInfo
methods.description: Constructs a status report including the most severe event level.

methods.name: getMostSevereLevelFromEvents
methods.description: Returns the highest severity level from logged events.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing current status, including config enabled state and events.

methods.name: renderEvent
methods.description: Converts a logged event into a JSON object for reporting.
